# Marcus Feld — Chief Financial Officer

- **Relationship:** peer on the exec team; owns budget, FP&A, and the financial side of
  [Falcon](../projects/falcon.md).
- **Cadence:** biweekly 1:1, Fridays; monthly infra-spend review.
- **What he cares about:** gross margin, cloud cost trajectory, and predictable capex/opex.
  The [Ledger](../projects/ledger.md) cost-optimization program is his favorite of Maya's.

## How to work with him
- Bring numbers with a clear unit economic story (cost per tenant, cost per pipeline run).
- He supports platform investment if you tie it to margin or to closing enterprise deals.
- Give him a heads-up before any large committed-spend contract (e.g. the Cascade vendor).

## Sensitivities
- Allergic to surprise overages; the June cloud bill spiked and he wants a written explanation.
